definitions.explanation: A place of Buddhist worship, distinct from Shinto shrines.

examples.english: I visit the temple during Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧お{寺|てら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Kyoto has many old temples, so it's popular with tourists.

notes:
{寺|てら} (also お{寺|てら}) is a Buddhist temple, distinct from ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧ (Shinto shrine).

TEMPLE vs SHRINE:
- {寺|てら}/⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧: Buddhist temple
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧: Shinto shrine

FAMOUS TEMPLES:
- ⟦{金閣寺|きんかくじ}→金閣寺：noentry⟧: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
- ⟦{清水寺|きよみずでら}→清水寺：noentry⟧: Kiyomizu-dera
- ⟦{東大寺|とうだいじ}→東大寺：noentry⟧: Todai-ji
- ⟦{浅草寺|せんそうじ}→浅草寺：noentry⟧: Senso-ji

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧{寺|てら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧: to visit a temple
- ⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧: temple (formal)
- 〜{寺|じ}/〜{寺|てら}: temple name suffix
